requirement_refs: Anti-pattern catalogue is sourced from WOPS

execution_conventions.prompt_gate: python scripts/prompt_migration_gate.py --json (run with conda env python)
execution_conventions.context_measure: python scripts/measure_context.py (run with conda env python)

models.selection_basis: usage-aware precedence; gauge 2026-10-11: rolling 0%, weekly 45%, monthly 26%; tracker check exit 0 for both

wops.root_source: .env WOPS_ROOT (local Google Drive checkout, valid filesystem path)

pre_existing_changes: worktree clean at run start (git status --short empty)
